original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹耶伊一名18岁学生遭枪击身亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹中赤道州耶伊镇以北约4公里的Hai Dileb地区，一名18岁学生Martin Wani于周二晚约7时返家途中遭一名身份不明的枪手开枪击中背部，送医后因失血过多死亡。据称该枪手事先藏匿于一处供水点附近，抢走其手机后开枪。当地警方表示案件已移交县警察局，调查仍在进行中，尚未锁定嫌疑人。

location.raw_text: Hai Dileb, Luparate Sub-Boma, about 4km north of Yei town, Central Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 一名18岁学生在南苏丹耶伊镇以北约4公里的Hai Dileb地区遭身份不明枪手开枪打死
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: An 18-year-old student has been shot dead by an unidentified gunman in Hai Dileb, Luparate Sub-Boma, about 4km north of Yei town, Central Equatoria State.

key_facts.fact: 死者为Excell国际学校高三学生Martin Wani，周二晚约7时返家途中遇袭
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victim, Martin Wani, a Senior Three student at Excell International School, was attacked at about 7pm on Tuesday while returning home from town.

key_facts.fact: 据称枪手藏匿于一处供水点附近，抢走其手机后从背后开枪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Local authorities said Martin encountered an armed man who had allegedly hidden near a water kiosk. The suspect reportedly robbed him of his mobile phone before shooting him in the back.

key_facts.fact: 伤者被送往耶伊民事医院，后因严重失血死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Martin was taken to Yei Civil Hospital for treatment but later died from severe blood loss.

key_facts.fact: 当地警方称案件已移交县警察局，调查仍在进行，尚未锁定枪手
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mario Kenyi, a CID officer at Luparate Police Outpost, confirmed that the case had been referred to the county police post for further action. He said investigations were under way to identify and arrest the suspected gunman.

uncertainties: 枪手身份尚未确认，警方仍在调查中
事件经过（藏匿于供水点附近、抢劫手机后开枪）为当地当局及家属转述，尚未获独立证实
目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
